Package simsgame.career

Class CareerPromotion

java.lang.Object
simsgame.career.CareerPromotion
public class CareerPromotion extends Object
CareerPromotion encapsulates the promotion structure for a career, including titles, pay rates, and promotion requirements. It provides getter methods to retrieve the appropriate title, pay rate, and promotion requirement based on the Sim's current level.
